instruction: Navigate to the press releases section on the Department of Justice website.

metadata.explanation: This task variation asks the agent to navigate to the press releases section on justice.gov. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'justice.gov/news' with 'type=press_release' parameter using the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match function. The task maintains similar structure and difficulty as the original task, changing from browsing forms to browsing press releases.

The metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' properly performs regex pattern matching on the URL
The expected pattern 'justice\.gov/news.*type=press_release' semantically matches the instruction requirement to navigate to the press releases section
Complete coverage: the evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires - presence of the press releases URL pattern
